root.label: Maduro and Flores superseding indictment for alleged torture

events.label: Maduro and Flores superseding indictment for alleged torture

slots.name: torture charge count
slots.sentence: Deposed Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, are now facing an additional charge of conspiracy to commit torture as federal prosecutors filed a superseding indictment in the Southern District of New York on Thursday.

slots.name: indictment page count
slots.sentence: The 30-page superseding indictment accuses the couple of overseeing a system of political repression that relied on Venezuela's military, intelligence agencies and security forces to torture their opponents, silence dissidents and maintain power.
